name: Godrej Sora
description: Godrej Sora is a development of 244 residences across four towers in Sector 53, steps from Golf Course Road, designed around Japanese Shibui aesthetics. Architecture is by Hafeez Contractor with landscape by Oracles, and each tower has two homes per core, private lift lobbies, and balconies of about 50 ft.
curation: Only two homes per core per tower, with private lift lobbies
Balconies of about 50 ft and 3.4 m floor-to-floor heights
The Shiki Clubhouse with an indoor onsen-inspired pool and a rooftop pool
connectivity: About 2.4 km to Central Plaza Mall
About 2.6 km to Heritage Xperiential School
Access to the Rapid Metro and NH48
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
